_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the converter element-mapping docs. Hand-curated from the Site Converter's recognizer registry (class-fw-site-converter-stitch.php) + block-builder node methods (class-fw-site-converter-mapper.php: n_heading, n_text, register_builder), cross-referenced against each shortcode's full options.php. Edit THIS file, then run `node scripts/gen-element-mapping.mjs` to regenerate ai-dev-kit/element-mapping/*.md. Do NOT hand-edit the generated .md files. Option 'status' vocabulary: native = the converter sets this native option from a source signal; via-css = the look is reproduced via scoped CSS / the unified styler / hi-fi base, but the NATIVE option is left empty (a candidate to promote to a native mapping); unmapped = left at default (no source signal, or a decorative choice with nothing to translate); auto = plumbing (unique id, custom attrs) — excluded from the coverage percentage. Coverage% = native / (native + via-css + unmapped).

native.label: Native
native.blurb: Set as the native option from the source.

via-css.label: Via CSS
via-css.blurb: Reproduced via scoped CSS / the styler; the native option is left empty (candidate to promote to a native mapping).

unmapped.label: Unmapped
unmapped.blurb: Left at default — no source signal, or a decorative choice with nothing to translate.

auto.label: Auto
auto.blurb: Plumbing (unique id, custom attrs). Excluded from the coverage percentage.

elements.label: Special Heading
elements.matchesWhen: A semantic heading tag (`<h1>`–`<h6>`), or a text node the heuristics score as a heading. Level ≤ 2 becomes a page **Title** (larger Display type); level ≥ 3 a section heading.
elements.blockShape: { t:'heading', html|text, level, align, cls, wrapCls, cs, overline, subtitle, wrapMaxW }
elements.recognizerNotes: A chip/badge sitting directly above the heading is pulled in as its overline (with the chip's inline SVG → `overline_icon`, rendered as a filled pill). Typography/size/color are re-asserted at specificity 0 (the hi-fi base) so it looks identical while staying editable.

options.source: Source eyebrow / kicker text above the title
The heading text (inline HTML accents preserved)
A supporting line captured right after the heading
Inline `<svg>` inside the source overline / preceding chip
Where the SVG sat relative to the overline text
Source title icons aren't extracted to this field
Only the master alignment is mapped
Title size reproduced via the hi-fi base + heading tag, not this option
Subtitle's computed font-size → nearest Text Style preset
Reproduced at specificity 0 via the hi-fi base; native option left empty
Source vertical margins → native margin option
Entrance animations default off (no source signal)
Carries the source font-weight + the hi-fi appearance base

elements.label: Text Block
elements.matchesWhen:
A paragraph / body-copy block (typically `

` or a text container) that isn't a heading, button, or other recognized primitive. Short ALL-CAPS or eyebrow-classed text is refined to an **overline** instead.
elements.recognizerNotes: A centered paragraph that also carries a source max-width keeps a proven inline `mx-auto` wrapper; a pure centered/right paragraph uses the native `text_align` option instead. Font / colour / line-height re-assert via the styler.

options.source: Body text colour reproduced via the section / preset styler; native option empty
Block background rarely set (section handles it)
Link colour via the styler; native option empty
Source computed font-size → nearest body Text Style preset
Vertical margins ride the unified styler; native margin option left empty
Explicit source center / right alignment (a `text-*` class)
Source max-width (class, inline style, or stylesheet rule)
Reproduced via the styler; native option empty
Decorative drop-cap (+ style/font/lines/chars/gap/colour) — no source signal
Left empty — the block carries no source classes here
